title: Apple announces departure of general counsel and policy chief
content: The two executives reported to Apple CEO Tim Cook and are the latest members of senior leadership to exit the iPhone maker.

title: Taiwan bans Chinese social media app RedNote for one year on fraud risks
content: It said that it will block access to the app, describing it as one that is "potentially becoming a high-risk area for online shopping fraud."

title: India cuts rates to 5.25% as expected as central bank flags ‘weakness in some key economic indicators’
content: India's central bank cut its policy rate by 25 basis points to 5.25%, matching forecasts from economists polled by Reuters.

title: Bids for WBD are in. Here's what Paramount, Comcast and Netflix could do with the assets
content: WBD's coveted library of content includes franchises like DC's superheroes, Harry Potter, Lord of the Rings, Game of Thrones, Looney Tunes and Scooby-Doo.

title: CNBC's Inside India newsletter: How a government app in India triggered a backlash over internet freedom
content: The Indian government asked phone manufacturers to preload a state-run cybersecurity app with no option to disable it, drawing a public backlash.

title: Nvidia has a cash problem — too much of it
content: Nvidia's recent slew of billion-dollar checks highlight the company's growing cash pile.

title: Bank of Japan faces a policy dilemma as government bond yields keep hitting new highs
content: Experts said the rise in yields is due to inflation running above target, hawkish remarks from the Bank of Japan and an expansionary fiscal policy.

title: CNBC Daily Open: It's a rich Nvidia's world
content: Nvidia had $60.6 billion in cash and short-term investments. That's up from $13.3 billion in January 2023, just after OpenAI released ChatGPT.

title: SoFi's stock drops on $1.5 billion share sale announcement
content: SoFi said it's selling $1.5 billion in stock after the company's market cap almost doubled this year.

title: Digital artist Beeple put his face on a $100K robot dog next to Elon Musk and Picasso – it sold first

title: Ex-Googler’s Yoodli triples valuation to $300M+ with AI built to assist, not replace, people
content: Yoodli counts Google, Snowflake, and Databricks among its customers.

title: Sources: AI synthetic research startup Aaru raised a Series A at a $1B ‘headline’ valuation

title: Waymo to issue software recall over how robotaxis behave around school buses
